Lust

Another silent night settles in around my harbor

WritingView full archive ↗

Another silent night settles in around my harbor

Passing souls glancing quick, never longer than the time it takes to see I too exist, however bleakly I exist

I’m a weak white flag floating sadly in this wide ocean of lust, attached to this dock that rarely rocks me enough

I teeter, RISE ?! ... and fall with her cycles

Idle, idle, idle, idle, idle, RREVVV

My preeminent passion propels me past the thought of her warm naked flesh dancing softly in my.. Hands

Skating down her shoulders,

Tracing valleys into gently rolling hills,

My every instinct enveloped in the motherly nature of her curves floating... temptingly ... across my field of vision

I’m utterly transfixed

I’m ...

Awakened by the Feeling of her branches raking through my scattered leaves

I hear her voice, subtle at first, then growing into cacophony so immense it takes over every sound echoing through my inner universe

Blinding Lightning rips across my sky

So bright it blurs our time together, and smears memories deep into the canvas of forever ...

But in between those fibers, dying sparks begin to scatter

Like sand pouring through my open hand, my unplanned fantasies dissolve

All I’m left with are fragments of an old feeling slowly fracturing away from my being

I reel back into a vacuum —! Lost ... ?

I’m ... back to my reality.

A weak white flag just

floating in a wide ocean of lust.

I’m ...
